featured_reviews.name: Komal Auti
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am a second-year engineering student, and my journey at the IGNITE Event Fashion Show was truly one of the most memorable experiences of my college life.
During the IGNITE event organized by our college, a fashion show was arranged, and I got the opportunity to participate in it. For our choreography, Kristina Ma’am and Pushpen Sir were appointed as our mentors. From 21st January to 31st January, we trained under their guidance, and the experience of working with them was absolutely fabulous. It was my first time participating in such a grand event, and throughout the journey, I felt myself growing more confident day by day.
Day 1
On the very first day, I had no prior experience and no clear idea about choreography or stage performance. However, once the practice began, Kristina Ma’am made everything feel comfortable. Slowly and steadily, she helped us build confidence. She is extremely calm, patient, and supportive. Even when we made mistakes repeatedly, she never scolded us. Instead, she focused on correcting us and teaching us again with the same dedication and positivity.
Day 2
On the second day, Ma’am helped everyone with costume practice as well. The practice sessions were continuous and intense, but neither Ma’am nor Sir ever showed tiredness. They practiced with us, put in equal effort, and stayed till late hours. Even while returning home late at night, they remained energetic and motivating, which inspired us even more.
Day 3
On the third day, I personally faced a bit of weakness and low confidence. Because of that, I sometimes forgot steps during practice. Kristina Ma’am noticed this and personally asked me if I was facing any problem. She encouraged me to share openly and assured me that we would work through it together. That support meant a lot to me. With every passing day, my confidence kept increasing. We practiced continuously for 4–5 hours, and since Ma’am and Sir practiced alongside us, the entire process felt enjoyable and motivating.
Day 4 & Day 5
During the last two days, several complications and challenges came up. However, Kristina Ma’am handled every situation very smartly and calmly. She encouraged us to stay focused and give our best despite the difficulties. Her motivation pushed us to practice with even more dedication and energy.
Day 6 – Final Day
The final day was truly the best and most exciting day. After so many days of hard work, our efforts were finally going to show results. Ma’am helped us with costumes, makeup, and overall presentation. Even when some costumes were not ready on time, she managed everything perfectly.
The most amazing part of the performance was the final dance, where we performed together with Sir and Ma’am. The performance was powerful, energetic, and truly a stage-breaking one. The result we had worked so hard for came out exactly the way we hoped.

This entire journey with the Dance and Fitness Team was more than just a performance—it was a lesson in confidence, discipline, teamwork, and dedication. I am extremely grateful to Kristina Ma’am and Pushpen Sir for their guidance, patience, and constant support.
This experience will always hold a special place in my heart and will remain one of the best memories of my college life.

-komal auti
Smt indira gandhi college of engineering
Se mechanical

featured_reviews.name: Vidhi Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
This review comes from someone who hadn’t danced for 40 years before walking into Dancamaze

At first, I was convinced this wasn’t for beginners like me. The steps felt impossible, my confidence was low, and I genuinely thought, “There’s no way I can ever get this right.” But then came Eshna and Pooja. The way they break down every step, with so much patience, clarity, and encouragement, completely changes everything. What once felt overwhelming suddenly feels doable. They don’t just teach dance — they make you believe in yourself.

Somewhere along the way, you stop saying “I can’t” and start thinking, “Maybe I actually can.” And that feeling? It’s priceless.

This has been such a joyful learning experience, filled with laughter, energy, and zero judgment. The vibe is electric, the atmosphere is alive, and the positivity in the room is truly next level. I haven’t just learned dance steps — I’ve rediscovered confidence, fun, and a part of myself I didn’t know I’d lost.

Thank you, Eshna and Pooja, for being absolute powerhouses of fun, warmth, and enthusiasm. You’re not just amazing teachers — you’re pure magic. ✨

featured_reviews.review_text: A big thanku to Eshna and Pooja for the amazing class n for teaching us such beautiful dance moves with so much ease n patience, had a wonderful experience, looking forward for the next class❤️

featured_reviews.name: krutika vankani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had such a wonderful experience with this dance class! What truly stood out to me was how effortlessly the instructors broke down even complex steps into something simple and easy to follow. As someone who has always been very conscious and hesitant about dancing, I never imagined I would feel this comfortable.
The classes beautifully cover a variety of dance styles, which keeps every session fresh and exciting. The instructors are incredibly professional, yet they bring so much energy and fun into the room that you can’t help but enjoy yourself.
What I appreciated the most is the non-judgmental and welcoming environment they’ve created. It’s a space where everyone feels encouraged, regardless of their skill level, and you can genuinely see how much the students enjoy being there.
This class truly made me look forward to every session—something I never thought I’d say as a non-dancer! Highly recommend it to anyone who wants to learn, have fun, and feel completely at ease while doing so.
Pooja eshna your energy is infectious ❤️

featured_reviews.review_text:
DnceAll Universe is amazing. They have fitness classes which is full of fun and you get to increase your strength, endurance in fun filled way. I have taken the classes and they are just amazing!! I have been able to increase my strength, flexibility and endurance  attending the classes.
I have also had chance to witness their choreography for dance and must say they are very creative. At the same time their teaching styles is good and you can learn in easy and fun way!!
Would recommend DnceAll Universe any day to all !!

featured_reviews.name: kshitija khade
featured_reviews.review_text: I've been attending classes with DnceAll Universe for the last three months and they are wonderful. All three instructors bring a wonderful energy to the class. I especially appreciate their responsiveness to queries students have during the class and the fact that they are always willing to hear you out even in the middle of the class and give you alternate exercises in case you can't keep up. The choreography is fun and diverse and they pace the class well to truly make it a good HIIT workout with a proper resistance/strength section included just begore the cool down. I've seen visible differences in myself post their classes and my mobility is much better now than it was when I started. Thanks guys and keep up the good work😊

featured_reviews.name: Minoti Merchant
featured_reviews.review_text: I came across Dnceall on instagram a few months ago and kept following their videos and fitness programs. It was just over 2 months that I finally decided to try out a session and see if I can manage their workouts. I have a history of a brain surgery which has reduced my stamina drastically and lack of physical exercise in last 7 years due to it has made my body stiff. The problem child in me also has osteoarthritis hence squats and jumps are tough to manage with knee pain. And I am also on hormone replacement therapy which keeps adding weight. So I am swimming against the flowing river water.... yet Dnceall fitness programme has started making a difference in how my body feels. My main aim was not to lose weight but to get fit, increase my stamina and get my stiff body to become flexible. And I can surely feel that happening. During the first two weeks, I used to be exhausted and dead after the workouts with bodyache lingering into the next session. But now I feel more energized. What used to be unbearable pain, now seems a bit bearable.... and that truly gives me hope. Hope... that I can get back to the fitness levels of what I was before my surgery. Tishya, Abhinav and Vidula are really great teachers, who let you work as per your limits yet inspire you with their enthusiasm and make you want to push yourself. Its been a fun few weeks and I know I still have a long way to go but I am glad I am on the right path with Dnceall.... which is actually a perfect name... Dance for all!!

featured_reviews.name: K ANUPAMA Nair
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to share my heartfelt appreciation for Dr. Vijayashree Pillai, my daughter’s Bharatanatyam teacher at Souparnika Dance Academy. She is truly an amazing teacher who teaches with so much love, dedication, and patience.

From the very first class, we saw how beautifully she connects with each student. She takes the time to explain every step clearly, corrects gently, and encourages the children with kind words. My daughter looks forward to every class and has grown so much in confidence and grace because of Dr. Vijayashree’s guidance.

What makes her special is her deep knowledge of Bharatanatyam and the way she brings meaning to every movement. She not only teaches the dance steps but also shares the story and emotion behind them, which helps the children understand the true spirit of the art form.

We feel very lucky to be part of Souparnika Dance Academy and to have a teacher like Dr. Vijayashree. Her passion for dance and her calm, positive approach truly inspire the students. Thank you for making the learning journey so joyful and meaningful for our daughter.

Highly recommend Souparnika and Dr. Vijayashree Pillai to anyone looking for a great classical dance teacher.
